newsitem.title: ITALY: MOTORCYCLING-BIAGGI CRASHES DURING SAN MARINO PRACTICE.
newsitem.headline: MOTORCYCLING-BIAGGI CRASHES DURING SAN MARINO PRACTICE.

text.p: Defending 250cc champion Max Biaggi of Italy crashed during Saturday's practice session for Sunday's San Marino Grand Prix.
Biaggi's Honda caught the back wheel of compatriot Luca Boscoscuro's bike as the rider tried to overtake on a right-hand curve during the morning's free practice session.
Biaggi fell off and slid about 30 metres across the track into a sand verge. He got up immediately, remounted the bike, completed the lap and rode into the pits.
Race organisers said Biaggi was unhurt and was expected to ride in the afternoon's qualifying session.
Biaggi, chasing his fourth world title, finished second in Friday's first qualifying practice behind championship leader Ralf Waldmann of Germany.
